name: labs/veerwang__octoaxes
title: Octoaxes 7-axis microscope stage
intro: Octoaxes 7-axis microscope stage, adapted from veerwang/octoaxes. It reads `x_position_um`, `y_position_um`, `z_steps`, `moving` and 2 more; runs `move_xy`, `set_illumination` and `deenergise`. `move_xy`: move the X and Y stage axes to absolute positions in micrometres. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/veerwang__octoaxes --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/veerwang__octoaxes --backend fake --mcp
